summary: The diff implements most of the required changes: Google Maps dependencies are removed from index.html, a new CustomMapView component using OpenStreetMap tiles is created, a CustomMarker component with teardrop/avatar styling is added, CommunityMapPanel.tsx is updated to use CustomMapView, and the README.md is updated. However, the README update appears minimal with only a brief heading and 'Getting Started' section but no actual documentation about the new OpenStreetMap implementation. The GoogleMapView.tsx file is listed as modified rather than removed, which may indicate it was cleaned up rather than deleted.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend/README.md to remove Google Maps API key setup instructions and replace with documentation explaining the new OpenStreetMap-based implementation requiring no API key.
missing_requirements.reason: The README.md diff shows only a minimal file with a title and 'Getting Started' section header but no actual documentation explaining the custom OpenStreetMap-based implementation. The requirement specifies that the README must document the new custom map implementation, not just be emptied.

hallucinated_features.description: Auto-fit map zoom to show all community members on first load using bounding box calculation
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention auto-fitting the map to show all members. REQ-2 only requires a sensible default world view.

hallucinated_features.description: Auto-pan to selected member with minimum zoom enforcement when a member is selected from the list
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify that the map should automatically pan to a selected member's location. REQ-3 only requires clicking a marker to open the info card.

hallucinated_features.description: LocateFixed locate-me button imported and presumably rendered in CustomMapView controls
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only specifies zoom-in and zoom-out control buttons. A locate or recenter button was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Pulse ring animation on selected markers using animate-ping
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify any animation effects on selected markers. A pulsing animation ring was not requested in any requirement.
